title: spark intermediate-render log row (JSONL, one object per line)

ts.description: UTC timestamp of the render, ISO-8601 (e.g. 2026-11-25T12:56:00Z).

agent.description: Agent/lane id that produced the render (e.g. spark-logger).

prompt.description: Full text prompt sent to the image/model generator.

seed.description: Generator seed, or null when the backend assigns one.

params.description: Free-form generation params (backend, size, steps, guidance, etc.).

render_path.description: Repo-relative path to the rendered image (PNG/WebP), relative to repo root.

model_path.description: Repo-relative path to the 3D model file (GLB/FBX/USDZ), or null when image-only.

note.description: Short human note: what this render is for / what to look at.
